name: Camping Insel Buchau am Staffelsee
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The camping site **"Insel Buchau"** is located at the Staffelsee** in the Tirol district of Reutte. The site accommodates caravans, campervans, and tents. The facilities include sanitary buildings, electrical hookups, and a waste and water disposal station. A direct lakeside access allows swimming and the use of small boats. In the surrounding area, hiking in the Ammergebirge and cycling along the lake’s shores are popular activities. The site is open year-round and is ideal for a peaceful stay in nature.
